_comment: Keyed by the exact country name string used in the world-atlas/Natural Earth dataset (properties.name), so the frontend can join by name with no ID lookup. Every country not listed here defaults to 'stable' in the UI — this is what makes the map 'measure' all ~180 countries, not just active conflicts. Tiers reflect active armed conflict / insurgency involvement only (an objective, documented fact), not a general geopolitical risk score — see README for the reasoning.
